papers: Microglia govern the extinction of acute stress-induced anxiety-like behaviors in male mice.

A noradrenergic pathway for the induction of pain by sleep loss.
A neural circuit for alcohol withdrawal–induced hyperalgesia in a nondependent state.
Up-regulation of HCN2 channels in a thalamocortical circuit mediates allodynia in mice.
Thalamocortical circuits drive remifentanil-induced postoperative hyperalgesia.
Up-regulation of acid-sensing ion channel 1a in the anterior cingulate cortex by INF-a/NF-kB pathway contributes to diabetes-related pain.
Early-life inflammation promotes depressive symptoms in adolescence via microglial engulfment of dendritic spines.

Green light induces antinociception via visual-somatosensory circuits.
A somatosensory cortex input to the caudal dorsolateral striatum controls comorbid anxiety in persistent pain.
Dexmedetomidine alleviates anxiety-like behavior in mice following peripheral nerve injury by reducing the hyperactivity of glutamatergic neurons in the anterior cingulate cortex.
